source: Indexed original NTSC raster160x210; supplied ROM authority
x_mapping: 8+floor(3*x/2); preserve every original source pixel with alternating1/2 display pixels; viewport8..247
y_mapping: source7..185 -> target0..178 and189..201 ->179..191, both1:1; omit0..6,186..188,202..209 only; verify every omitted row black per fixture. Removes3 blank separator rows, retains edge-shifted footer199.
palette: Nearest squared-distance nominal TMS RGB, ties lower nontransparent index. If measured RGB chroma(max-min)>=24, exclude black/gray/white to preserve chromatic water/sky/object identity. Observed ALE RGB lookup; approximation, not physical color fidelity.
screen2_fit: Offline background plus sprite repairs, deduplicated patterns+colors per64-line bank, at most192tile IDs/bank, duplicate name pages1800/1C00, patterns0000/colors2000/SAT1B00/SPT3800;16384VRAM bytes
overcolor: Keep two most frequent colors per8-pixel row, ties lower index; map others to nearest retained RGB, then restore every lost mapped pixel through16x16 sprite color planes. Reject more than32slots or4slot rectangles on any scanline. No final mapped-pixel loss allowed in canonical capture.
runtime_boundary: No ROM or native renderer change; fit compiler is not a dynamic frame uploader or timing acceptance. New native graphics integration must remeasure all layouts/widths/SPACE/NTSC/PAL and logical-state invariance.
mechanics: Mapping consumes raster copies only; never changes canonical source RAM, collisions or game time
local_only: ROMs, decoded catalog, source/target pixels, VRAM, complete frames and original-derived assembly remain ignored
